newsitem.title: GERMANY: Spiegel, German railway to print daily newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel, German railway to print daily newspaper.

text.p: The publisher of Germany's Spiegel magazine said on Thursday it was teaming up with the German railway Deutsche Bahn to publish what it called "the fastest newspaper in the world".
Spiegel said the newspaper will be published on weekdays and Sunday and be electronically transmitted to Deutsche Bahn's high-speed ICE trains, where the papers will be printed.
The newspaper, which will have a circulation of up to 20,000 and will begin publishing sometime in 1997, will be sent out at about 1600 to 1700 local time to the trains.
First-class passengers on the trains will receive complimentary copies while those in second-class must pay for the newspaper.
